title: Toward Generalizable Deep Learning Based Peatland Fire Detection via Walsh Hadamard Transform and Domain Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2603.02465v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Machine learning-based wildfire detection has advanced significantly using deep learning models trained on large wildfire image and video datasets. However, peatland fires exhibit distinct characteristics, including smoldering combustion, low flame intensity, persistent smoke, and subsurface burning, limiting the effectiveness of conventional wildfire detectors. To address these challenges, we propose an efficient deep learning framework for peatland fire detection based on a Walsh--Hadamard Transform enhanced ResNet-50 (WHT-ResNet-50), which improves feature representation while reducing model complexity. To enable efficient deployment, the training-time architecture is structurally reparameterized into an equivalent inference model without sacrificing detection performance. translated_title: 基于沃尔什-哈达玛变换与域自适应的泛化性泥炭地火灾深度学习检测研究
translated_abstract: 基于机器学习的野火检测利用在大型野火图像和视频数据集上训练的深度学习模型取得了显著进展。然而，泥炭地火灾表现出独特的特征，包括阴燃燃烧、低火焰强度、持续烟雾和地下燃烧，这限制了传统野火检测器的有效性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种基于沃尔什-哈达玛变换增强的ResNet-50（WHT-ResNet-50）的高效泥炭地火灾检测深度学习框架，该框架在降低模型复杂度的同时改进了特征表示。为了实现高效部署，训练时的架构被结构性地重参数化为等效的推理模型，且不牺牲检测性能。此外，所提出的框架通过迁移学习实现了从野火到泥炭地的域自适应，并引入了一种混合域训练策略……
tldr: 提出了一种结合沃尔什-哈达玛变换增强ResNet-50与野火到泥炭地域自适应的高效泥炭地火灾检测框架，通过结构重参数化在降低模型复杂度的同时提升了对泥炭地火灾独特特征的泛化检测能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an efficient peatland fire detection framework combining a Walsh-Hadamard Transform enhanced ResNet-50 with wildfire-to-peatland domain adaptation, using structural reparameterization to reduce model complexity while improving generalizable detection of peatland fire characteristics.
